nav.title: Settings
nav.description: Manage your account and workspace settings.

notificationsPage.loginRequired: Log in to change your notification settings.

paymentsPage.loginRequired: Log in to see your payment history.

account.title: My account
account.label: Account settings
account.name: Account name
account.nameHint: Change the name shown in a workspace on the Members tab.

accountDeletion.title: Delete account
accountDeletion.description: Deletes your account and the workspaces only you use, and logs you out on every device. This can't be undone.

dialog.title: Delete your account?
dialog.description: This can't be undone. If you sign up again with the same Google account, you'll get a new account.

reason.label: Reason for leaving
reason.note: Reasons are kept only as anonymous statistics.

plan.label: What happens to each workspace
plan.empty: You don't belong to any workspace.
plan.deleteSolo: Only you use this workspace, so it will be deleted.
plan.leaveShared: Others still use this workspace, so you'll only leave it.
plan.soleAdmin: You're the only admin. Transfer the admin role or delete the workspace.
plan.deleteWorkspace: Delete workspace (every member gets an email)

effects.label: What's deleted and what stays
effects.deleted: We immediately delete your account information and the <nowrap>meeting records (notes, transcripts, audio)</nowrap> of workspaces only you use or chose to delete.
effects.conversations: Your agent chats in every workspace are deleted.
effects.sharedHistory: Your name and what you said stay in past meeting records of shared workspaces.
effects.external: Anything already sent to outside tools (Linear, GitHub) and emails already sent stay.
effects.retained: Some information, like inquiry history, is kept for a set period and then deleted.

accountDeletion.recordingBlocked: Stop recording before you delete your account.

workspace.title: General
workspace.intro: Manage this workspace's name and description.
workspace.name: Workspace name

workspaceDeletion.title: Delete workspace
workspaceDeletion.description: Deletes everything, including <nowrap>meeting records (notes, transcripts, audio),</nowrap> and immediately blocks access for every member. Members are notified by email.
workspaceDeletion.recordingBlocked: Stop recording before you delete the workspace.

dialog.title: Delete this workspace?
dialog.description: Everything in this workspace, including <nowrap>meeting records (notes, transcripts, audio),</nowrap> will be deleted. This can't be undone. Anything already sent to outside tools (Linear, GitHub) and emails already sent stay.

members.title: Members
members.description: Manage this workspace's members and pending invitations.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
removeDialog.description: {email} will lose access to this workspace. Their agent chats here will also be deleted.

renameDialog.label: Name shown in this workspace
renameDialog.hint: Leave it empty to show the account name ({name}).

leave.title: Leave workspace
leave.description: You'll lose access to this workspace's meeting records and projects. To come back, you'll need a new invitation.

dialog.title: Leave this workspace?
dialog.description: You'll lose access to its meeting records and projects, and your agent chats in this workspace will be deleted.

invite.title: Invite members
invite.description: Invite people by email. People without an account can sign up through the link in the invitation.

guests.title: Guest participants
guests.description: People who joined meetings without an account. You can link them to their accounts later.
guests.lockedPartial: Couldn't load the full list, so you can't link or delete guest participants.
guests.lockedStale: Couldn't check the latest list, so you can't link or delete guest participants.
guests.noteCount: {count, plural, one {# meeting note} other {# meeting notes}}

addDialog.title: Add guest participant
addDialog.description: Add someone who'll join meetings without an account.

linkDialog.title: Link {name} to an account
linkDialog.choose: Choose the member to link this person to.
linkDialog.willChange: {count, plural, one {# meeting note will change.} other {# meeting notes will change.}}
linkDialog.changed: {count, plural, one {# meeting note changed.} other {# meeting notes changed.}}

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.lookupFailed: Couldn't check what this affects. Nothing is deleted until we know how many meeting notes would change.
deleteDialog.gone: Already deleted. Someone else probably deleted it first.
deleteDialog.description: {count, plural, one {This person is removed from # meeting note} other {This person is removed from # meeting notes}}, and their speaker links are removed too. This can't be undone.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose which notifications you get. These apply to every workspace.
notifications.label: Notification settings

descriptions.MEETING_PAUSED_REMINDER: Reminders and notices when a meeting ends automatically
descriptions.ANALYSIS_READY: When a meeting's analysis is done and results are ready to review
descriptions.INQUIRY_ANSWERED: When the HeyMoa team replies to your inquiry

help.pausedReminder: If you leave a meeting paused, we'll email you after 1 business day.
help.pausedAutoEnd: After 3 business days, we end the meeting, start the analysis, and send one more email.

web.label: In-app
web.missing: This notification isn't sent in the app

email.label: Email
email.missing: This notification isn't sent by email

muteAll.label: Turn off all in-app notifications
muteAll.title: Turn off all in-app notifications?
muteAll.body: You won't get optional in-app notifications. Turn this back on to restore your previous settings.

muteEmail.label: Turn off all email
muteEmail.title: Turn off all email?
muteEmail.body: You won't get optional notification emails. Turn this back on to restore your previous settings.

reset.title: Reset notification settings to defaults?
reset.body: Paused meeting emails and in-app notifications for results ready to review will turn back on.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: The chatbot uses this workspace's integrations to create or look up issues from meetings.
integrations.roleFailed: Couldn't check your permissions, so you can't connect or disconnect.
integrations.adminOnly: Only admins can connect or disconnect integrations. If you need a new integration, ask an admin.

toast.updateApp: Update the app, then connect again.
toast.startFailedLater: Couldn't start connecting. Try again in a moment.

card.needsConnection: Connect this tool so the chatbot can use it.

workspaceAgents.title: MCP connections
workspaceAgents.description: Decide whether teammates can connect this workspace to AI apps like Claude or ChatGPT. Admins can see connected apps and disconnect them.
workspaceAgents.roleFailed: Couldn't check your permissions, so you can't change MCP settings.
workspaceAgents.adminOnly: Only admins can change MCP connections.

allow.title: Allow MCP connections
allow.on: Teammates can give AI apps like Claude or ChatGPT access to this workspace.
allow.off: Off, so no new connections can be made.

offDialog.title: Turn off MCP connections?
offDialog.descriptionCount: {count, plural, one {The # active connection will be disconnected} other {All # active connections will be disconnected}} and won't come back if you turn this on again. While it's off, no one can connect to this workspace.
offDialog.description: All active connections will be disconnected and won't come back if you turn this on again. While it's off, no one can connect to this workspace.

dialog.title: Disconnect “{name}”?
dialog.description: {user} granted this connection. Agents using it are blocked from their next request. This can't be undone, and the person who granted it has to connect again to use it.

agentConnections.title: My MCP connections
agentConnections.description: Connect AI apps like Claude or ChatGPT so they can read meetings and projects in the workspaces you choose.

revokeReason.MEMBERSHIP_ENDED: Disconnected because you left the workspace.
revokeReason.REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED: Disconnected because the token was reused. It may have leaked, so connect again from your agent.
revokeReason.AGENT_ACCESS_DISABLED: Disconnected because the workspace turned off MCP connections.

list.label: My connections
list.emptyNever: You haven't connected an agent yet.
list.emptyNow: No agents are connected right now.
list.emptyHint: Add the address from New connection to your agent and allow it in the browser. It will show up here.

past.toggle: {count, plural, one {# past connection} other {# past connections}}
past.label: Past connections

issued.label: New token
issued.title: Created the “{name}” connection
issued.once: This token is shown only once. Copy it now, because you can't see it again after closing.
issued.claudeCode: Claude Code: paste in your terminal
issued.codex: Codex CLI: paste in your terminal
issued.scopeNote: Claude Code connects only in the folder where you ran the command. To use it in any folder, add --scope user. Codex connects in every folder. The Codex block replaces any existing heymoa entry, so it's safe to paste again. If you already added Claude Code, remove it first with claude mcp remove heymoa.

dialog.title: Revoke “{name}”?
dialog.description: Agents using this token are blocked from their next request. This can't be undone. To use it again, connect again.

usage.label: Activity
usage.empty: No agent has used a tool through this connection yet.
usage.nextFailed: Couldn't load more activity. Try Show more again.

terms.title: Custom vocabulary
terms.help: Add product names, internal terms, and acronyms that transcription often gets wrong. HeyMoa uses them when transcribing every meeting in this workspace. You don't need to add common words.
terms.placeholder: Paste terms separated by commas or line breaks
terms.full: Your custom vocabulary is full. Delete a term to add another.
terms.previewHint: Separate terms with commas (,), line breaks, semicolons, or tabs to preview them here.
terms.keyHint: Enter to add · Shift+Enter for a new line

outcome.failed: Couldn't send {count}. They're back in the input, so try again

appUpdates.title: App updates
appUpdates.description: Keep HeyMoa up to date on this device.
appUpdates.upgradeRequired: This app does not support in-app updates. Install the new version once to update from here in the future.
appUpdates.automaticHint: Download new versions automatically and install when you quit after recording and uploads finish. When turned off, you can still see new versions and choose when to download and install them.
appUpdates.restartBlocked: Restart is unavailable while recording or audio uploads are pending. Finish recording and uploading first. Restart is also blocked until the app can confirm the recording status.
appUpdates.failed: The update request failed. Please try again.

status.idle: Checking for updates automatically downloads any new version.
status.ready: Version {version} is ready. Restart to apply it.
status.installing: Restarting the app to apply the update.
status.error: The update could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
status.unavailable: Updates cannot be installed in development mode.

appUpdates.nativeSettingsNotice: Manage app updates in desktop settings.
